axes.requirements: All ten acceptance criteria trace to code and evidence; the feature remains physical-mail tracking and does not expand into email marketing.
axes.architecture: Domain summary, application commands, repository interface, memory/Supabase implementations, CLI, server actions, and React presentation are separated and reuse existing project seams.
axes.security: Server validation, opaque bounded IDs, fixed owner filters, same-owner composite foreign keys, RLS replacement, safe error messages, and fail-closed live CLI configuration are present.
axes.data_integrity: One row per campaign/contact, first-date preservation on repeated mark, idempotent unmark, explicit missing-resource errors, migration backfill, and no destructive history rewrite.
axes.ux_accessibility: Apple-inspired tokens, system type, grouped surfaces, 44px controls, named role=checkbox controls, pending/error states, search, 390px containment, light/dark, reduced motion, and honest demo state.
axes.testing: 85 tests expected after the final suite, plus lint, typecheck, four CLI commands, production build, create-mark-reload-unmark runtime flow, mobile light/dark screenshots, and zero browser console entries.
